title: Critical lowered-Bose phase-space mixing check; mass conservation closed thermal Lagrangian patch
analytic_lowF: For exactly bounded final phase-space support and unbounded initial thermal momentum, with equal total N, D_final(F)-D_initial(F) ~ +C_initial F [ln(1/F)]^3 as F->0; so no exact closed collisionless mixing.
limitations: Not a fundamental 86-eV exclusion. Tidal escaping, nonthermal initial spectra, noise, finite sensitivity and collisions can evade strict closed sharp-cutoff assumptions.
